Recipe.name: Newcomb Taco Pizza
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, cook beef until browned. Drain. 2. Add taco seasoning and water. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until mixture thickens, 4 to 6 minutes. 3. Chill. 4. Preheat conv oven to 375 F, impinger oven to 500 F. FOR 1 PIZZA: 1. On 16" pizza screen coated with cooking spray, place 1 frozen dough. 2. Top dough with the following: 6-oz spoodle salsa 2 each 8-oz spoodles cheddar 3-oz spoodle olives 3-oz spoodle jalapeno 6-oz spoodle filling 3. Bake until crust is browned and cheese is bubbly, conv oven 6-8 minutes or impinger oven 4-6 minutes. 4. Cut into 1/8 wedges.

Recipe.name: Newcomb Chopped Italian Herb Blend
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. De-stem and finely mince oregano leaves. 2. De-stem and chop parsley & basil. 3. Combine, cover & refrigerate for service.

Recipe.name: Newcomb Street Corn Pizza
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 450 F or impinger oven to 500 F. 2. In stockpot over medium-high heat, cook beef until browned. Drain. 3. Add taco seasoning and water. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until mixture thickens, 4 to 6 minutes. 4. Chill. 5. Preheat dough press to 140 F. Preset dough press timer to 8 seconds. 6. Coat bottom plate of dough press with cooking spray. Place 1 Dough in center of press. Coat with cooking spray. 7. Close press. Timer will beep after 8 seconds. Open press. Dough should be 16" in diameter. 8. Dock Dough to minimize blistering during baking. FOR 1 ROUND PIZZA: On 16" pizza screen coated with cooking spray, place 1 docked Dough. FOR 1 RECTANGULAR PIZZA: On half sheet pan coated with cooking spray, place 1 docked Dough. Gently stretch Dough to 18" x 13” rectangle. 1. Top Dough with the following: 6-oz spoodle poblano cream sauce 2 each 8-oz spoodles cheese blend 8-oz spoodle Roasted corn blend Bake until crust is browned and cheese is bubbly, convection oven 4 to 6 minutes or impinger oven 4 to 5 minutes. 2. Top with cotija, cilantro & Tajin 2. Cut ROUND pizza into 1/8 wedges or RECTANGULAR pizza 4 x 2 into 8 portions.

Recipe.name: Caramelized Onion & Pepper Pizza
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Remove dough from refrigerator. Let rise at room temperature until doubled in size, 1 ½ to 2 hours. 2. Preheat convection oven to 450 F or impinger oven to 500 F. 3. Preheat dough press to 140 F. Preset dough press timer to 8 seconds. FOR 1 PIZZA: 1. Coat bottom plate of dough press with cooking spray. Place 1 dough ball in center of press. Coat dough with cooking spray. 2. Close press. Timer will beep after 8 seconds. Open press. Dough should be 16" in diameter. Dock dough to minimize blistering during baking. 3. On 16" pizza screen coated with cooking spray, place docked dough. 4. Top dough with the following: 6-oz spoodle Sauce 2 each 8-oz spoodles mozzarella 4-oz spoodle Onions 4-oz spoodle Peppers 5. Bake until crust is browned and cheese is bubbly, convection oven 4 to 6 minutes or impinger oven 4 to 5 minutes. 6. Cut 1/8
Recipe.special_instructions: *Low speed is 1st speed on a 3-speed mixer and 2nd speed on a 4-speed mixer. **Randomly check weight of portioned cookie dough on scale prior to baking. ***Baking time may vary depending on the oven and oven load.

Recipe.name: Black Olive Pizza

Preheat conv oven to 450 F, std oven to 500 F or impinger oven to 500 F. Preheat dough press to 140 F. Preset dough press timer to 8 seconds. For one pizza: Coat bottom plate of dough press with cooking spray. Place 1 dough ball (19 ozw) in center of press. Coat dough with cooking spray. Close press. Timer will beep after 8 seconds. Open press. Dough should be 16" in diameter. Dock dough to minimize blistering during baking. 1. On 16" pizza screen coated with cooking spray, place docked dough. 2. Top dough with the following: 6-oz spoodle Sauce (6 ozw) 2 each 8-oz spoodles mozzarella (8 ozw) 8-oz spoodle olives (4 1/2 ozw) 3. Bake until crust is browned and cheese is bubbly, conv oven 4-6 minutes, std oven 12-14 minutes or impinger oven 4-5 minutes. 4. Cut 1/8
